notes.title: Changes to the sword and shield system to increase realism.
notes.notes:
To increase the sense of realism
Swords are now generated and erased by the player, rather than coming out on their own.
Shields are no longer placed on the spot, but instead follow the player's left hand. The shield is no longer placed in place, but instead follows the player's left hand or hand. (Attacks are not possible.)

Also, fixed a number of inconvenient and confusing laser pointers for the UI.
